name: Cross-physics magnetic/gravity edge-normal concordance
layers: Competition bands: rtp, tmi_hg/tmi_vg, iso_grav_anom, iso_grav_anom_hg/iso_grav_anom_vg
signature: At matched 200 m and 500 m scales, normalize edge strength and compare magnetic/gravity edge-normal orientation; retain coincident, similarly oriented edges.
why_new_faults: Magnetic susceptibility and density contrasts can persist under cover. Concordant, aligned edges may reveal structure with weak relief; this is a mechanism hypothesis, not proof of hidden-fault performance.
differs_from: Existing features include single-field lineament transforms and H-E multi-physics coincidence, but do not combine magnetic/gravity edge-normal orientation at matched scales.
expected_dti: Rank 1 qualitative; moderate uncertain upside, but no numerical forecast was preregistered.
cost: Medium; existing competition layers, no new download.
external_data_needed: None beyond hash-pinned competition feature layers; hidden expert labels remain unavailable to the local holdout.
outcome: Partial implementation failed the frozen promotion rule: mean proxy DTI 0.2796713 vs H-D 0.2816627, delta -0.0019913, positive in 3/6 folds. The preregistered family listed RTP, TMI HG/VG, and gravity HG/VG; the measured builder used only rank-normalized comp_tmi and comp_iso_grav_anom as inputs to the new transform (the derivative bands remained in the common baseline stack). This does not falsify every version of the broader layer-family hypothesis.

name: Paired scarp-face asymmetry
layers: Owner-mirrored 1 m DEM-derived up-face, down-face, cross-face, step, and relief layers.
signature: Robust paired up-facing/down-facing gradient asymmetry or polarity ratios relative to local relief, instead of ranking absolute scarp amplitude.
why_new_faults: A low-relief but asymmetric surface step can be fault-related even when its absolute amplitude is weak; ratios may reduce sensitivity to local relief scale.
differs_from: H-D measures directional gradient coherence/persistence; no paired face-asymmetry ratio was included in the tested feature stack.
external_data_needed: No new source expected; owner-mirror provenance should be recorded. Not yet tested.
outcome: Not tested; no promotion or slot eligibility implied.

name: Geothermal manifestations aligned with an independent lineament
layers: GDR/INGENIOUS well and spring coordinates, temperature/geochemistry, plus an independently detected geophysical lineament.
signature: Measure point-to-lineament distance and orientation for spatially coherent thermal/geochemical manifestations; do not emit a broad habitat surface.
why_new_faults: A coherent group of warm manifestations aligned with a structural edge may indicate a permeable fluid pathway; alignment is more fault-specific than generic geothermal favorability.
differs_from: No current model feature uses well/spring temperature or chemistry and its directional relation to a separate lineament detector.
expected_dti: Rank 3 qualitative; low-to-moderate, highly uncertain upside.
external_data_needed: Validate GDR 1391 owner-mirrored CSV provenance, source IDs, duplicate sites, units, coordinates, and missingness before use. Not yet tested.
outcome: Not tested; no promotion or slot eligibility implied.

name: Stress-compatible structural corridors
layers: USGS Siler (2022) slip-/dilation-tendency release, joined to independently detected lineament orientation.
signature: A broad prior for mapped stress-compatible orientations and potential dilational corridors; not a point placer.
why_new_faults: Fault orientations favorably situated for slip or dilation under the ambient stress field may be more permeable; a corridor aligned with independent edges could indicate a hidden continuation or splay.
differs_from: The current Stage 1 is a geodetic-versus-mapped-fault strain budget, not a stress/tendency surface.
expected_dti: Rank 4 qualitative; potentially moderate but very uncertain.
cost: High; archive acquisition, schema/units audit, spatial join, and blocked evaluation.
external_data_needed: USGS ScienceBase DOI 10.5066/P9YL58W6. The release page was reviewed, but the shapefile download and field units are not locally validated; candidate is blocked until they are.
outcome: Blocked; rationale alone is not a validation result.
